output.summary: A cultivated squash originating in South America, particularly northern Argentina near the Andes or in some Andean valleys. Its many forms include all giant pumpkins, while edible cultivars may be roasted, baked or mashed into soup.
output.edibilityNote: Cultivars are roasted, baked or mashed into soup; the skin, flesh and seeds of JAP/Kent pumpkin are all edible.
